A risk is a possible event that has not yet occurred. It typically can have a negative impact and should be managed to prevent the project from going off track in the future. A risk unmanaged, accepted, or not fully mitigated usually becomes an issue.

Risk should be examined through various dimensions, such as strategic, operational, financial, regulatory, reputational, technical and others.

Any member of the team can identify project risks at any time; however, it is best to review the risks as part of regular project control meetings and to have someone designated to maintain version control over the register.
To capture uncertain events or conditions that, if each event occurs, have a positive or negative effect on one or more project objectives.
